scoring_justification: Magnetic moment and energy thresholds derived from paper's reported values to verify magnetic (Mn) vs nearly non-magnetic (Fe) character; recomputing from raw DFT output in the verifier is infeasible.

hidden_assets.purpose: Thresholds for magnetic character derived from paper reported values: Mn moment 1.84 μB, Fe moment 0.04 μB, Mn energy 5.319 mRy, Fe energy 0.001 mRy.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reports Mn magnetic moment 1.84 μB/atom, Fe 0.04 μB/atom; magnetic energies 5.319 mRy and 0.001 mRy.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Set thresholds capturing magnetic (Mn moment >1.0, Mn energy >1.0) vs non-magnetic (Fe moment <0.5, Fe energy <0.1).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Thresholds directly based on paper's numeric results, preserving the qualitative conclusion.

outputs.description: The checker compares the computed magnetic moments and stabilization energies against predetermined thresholds to determine the magnetic character (magnetic vs. non-magnetic) of each impurity. The thresholds are set to capture the qualitative behavior and accommodate differences in methodology.
Ionic relaxation log for impurity supercells

output_contract.notes: The task uses a supercell approach and open-source DFT to reproduce the paper's qualitative magnetic character. Tolerances are set to absorb differences from code/functional choices; exact numerical match is not required. The agent must perform the DFT calculations, not merely look up reported values.
